behavioral_intents: Adversaries creating scheduled tasks via PowerShell cmdlets or script hosts to establish persistence or scheduled execution of malicious payloads.
Attackers using legitimate Windows tools (CertUtil and BitsAdmin) to download files from remote servers, typically as part of malware delivery or data exfiltration workflows.
Attacker persistence via registry Run/RunOnce keys pointing to application updaters (Teams, Google Update, VS Code, Slack) that execute on logon
Detect mshta.exe as a parent process executing shell commands through inline VBScript or JavaScript, which is a known technique for script-based process injection and code execution.
Detect the use of scripting hosts (PowerShell, cmd, wscript, mshta, regsvr32) with window-hiding or shell-object invocation parameters that are commonly used to execute code covertly.

Detects BITS job lifecycle management operations (create, add file, resume, set notification, complete) which are used by attackers for stealthy background file transfer or persistence payload orchestration.
